quotes.text: Entry310 holds the test alert open1000ms to absorb repeats, but Bug1894672 was reopened and later logging found different IMAP/POP server errors in parallel. Its eventual WORKSFORME state came from bulk stale-bug closure. Current alert suppression is keyed by server and alert kind, for5sec or until completion, while current tests still have the1000ms delay. Model distinct concurrent alerts separately from duplicates and seek observable completion when practical. This study does not establish that the intermittent is fixed.
